title: Layer 2 round 1 major QE+DE+SE: three integrity checks and active_composition are unfalsified — deletable mutants
description: The corpus runner (convergence_red_gate.rs:45) never compares active_composition despite the every-field-exact-match claim; three of five integrity kinds (owner/validator, closed-evidence, unresolvable-handles) have zero corpus coverage against the declared mirror-pinning; round-parity's inequality and the actives guard are surviving mutants. Disposition: add active_composition to the comparison; add one fixture per uncovered kind and an agreeing-counts negative; assert the corpus size exactly (eleven, not >=10). Owner: quality-engineer. Validator: data-engineer.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in d84109f5: the runner now asserts active_composition echoes the state verbatim, requires exactly 15 fixtures (a skipped directory can no longer read as coverage), and checks determinism over the whole corpus. Four fixtures added as DRAFT ORACLES awaiting operator adoption, each with rationale comments: integrity-missing-owner, integrity-closed-no-evidence, integrity-unresolvable-handle (the three snapshot-integrity kinds previously untested positive), and round-parity-agreeing (the negative control). The derivation reproduced all four drafts first pass.
